_meta.description: Static lint rules for ABAP Cloud (ABAP language version 5, 'ABAP for Cloud Development') as enforced in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition developer extensibility. These mirror what ATC with check variant SAP_CP_READINESS / ABAP_CLOUD_DEVELOPMENT would reject.
_meta.note: This lint is a fast local pre-check, not a replacement for ATC in the tenant. Anything flagged 'error' will not activate or will fail ATC in Public Cloud.

rules.message: BAPIs are not released in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and cannot be called from custom code.
rules.alternative: Use the released OData/SOAP API for this object (search_released_apis tool), or a released BAdI for in-transaction logic.

rules.message: CALL TRANSACTION is not available in ABAP for Cloud Development (no SAP GUI, no dynpro).
rules.alternative: Use a released API or RAP behavior implementation.

rules.message: SUBMIT (classical reports) is not available in ABAP Cloud.
rules.alternative: Use Application Jobs (released job catalog entries/templates) or a RAP action.

rules.message: Classical reports (REPORT programs) cannot be created in Public Cloud developer extensibility.
rules.alternative: Build a RAP-based Fiori list report or an ABAP class run as an application job.

rules.message: FORM/PERFORM subroutines are obsolete and forbidden in ABAP Cloud.
rules.alternative: Use class methods.

rules.message: TABLES statement is forbidden in ABAP Cloud.
rules.alternative: Use typed data declarations against released CDS views.

rules.message: Native SQL (EXEC SQL) is not allowed in ABAP Cloud.
rules.alternative: Use ABAP SQL on released CDS views; for HANA-native needs use AMDP only where the used objects are released.

rules.message: Classical list output (WRITE) does not exist in ABAP Cloud.
rules.alternative: Return data via RAP/OData and display in Fiori; for developer diagnostics use application log (BALI released APIs) or console (if_oo_adt_classrun).

rules.message: Selection screens are dynpro-based and not available in ABAP Cloud.
rules.alternative: Model filters as OData query options on a RAP service, or application job parameters.

rules.message: Direct file system access is not available in Public Cloud.
rules.alternative: Use released XCO library (XCO_CP_*) capabilities, document management APIs, or file-based integration via BTP/CPI.

rules.message: Kernel calls are forbidden.
rules.alternative: Use released APIs only.

rules.message: Direct DML on SAP standard tables is strictly forbidden (and these tables are not even readable in Public Cloud custom code).
rules.alternative: Use the released API or BAdI for the business object.

rules.message: Classical SAP tables are not released for Public Cloud custom code — this SELECT will not compile.
rules.alternative: Use the released CDS interface view instead (check_object_release_state tool maps table -> I_* view).

rules.message: Dynpro/module pool technology does not exist in Public Cloud.
rules.alternative: Build a Fiori Elements app on a RAP service.

rules.message: Dynamic program generation is forbidden.
rules.alternative: Not permitted in Public Cloud at all.

rules.message: Function modules are generally not released in Public Cloud (very few exceptions).
rules.alternative: Verify the FM has release contract C1 in ADT Released Objects; otherwise use a released class/API.

rules.message: Several sy- fields are restricted/deprecated in ABAP Cloud (time zone correctness, testability).
rules.alternative: Use XCO library: xco_cp=>sy->user( ), xco_cp_time=>moment( ) etc., or cl_abap_context_info.

rules.message: WAIT UP TO is discouraged and often forbidden in cloud ATC variants.
rules.alternative: Redesign; for async patterns use RAP actions + events or application jobs.

rules.message: GUI control framework (cl_gui_*) does not exist in Public Cloud.
rules.alternative: Fiori/UI5 frontend on a RAP service.

rules.message: Implicit/explicit enhancements do not exist in Public Cloud — extensibility is only via released BAdIs, key user tools, or side-by-side.
rules.alternative: search_released_badis tool, or side-by-side extension on BTP.
